name: TCR-alpha-beta-positive T-cell deficiency

criteria.description: Marked reduction or absence of TCR-alpha-beta-positive T cells in peripheral blood
Immunophenotyping showing decreased CD3+ T cells with preserved or increased gamma-delta T cells
Recurrent severe infections consistent with T-cell immunodeficiency
Identification of pathogenic variants affecting TCR-alpha-beta T-cell development (if available)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of marked reduction of TCR-alpha-beta-positive T cells with clinical evidence of immunodeficiency and supportive immunophenotyping
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may aid but is not mandatory for diagnosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Profound deficiency of circulating TCR-alpha-beta-positive T lymphocytes
searchTerms: immune deficiency with low TCR-alpha-beta cells
severe repeated infections from weak germs
chronic yeast infections on skin and mucous
ongoing viral infections like CMV or EBV
failure to gain weight as baby

common.symptomName: Lymphopenia with low CD4+ T-cell counts

occasional.symptomName: Chronic diarrhea due to gastrointestinal infections

searchTerms: immune cell clusters causing organ damage

laboratory: Severe reduction or absence of TCR-alpha-beta-positive T cells on flow cytometry
Lymphopenia with low CD3+ and CD4+ T-cell counts
Elevated serum IgM with low or normal IgG and IgA
imaging: Chest imaging may show opportunistic infections or lymphoid tissue abnormalities
other: Impaired T-cell proliferative responses to mitogens and antigens
Normal or increased gamma-delta T-cell populations

distinguishingFeatures: Profound deficiency of both T and B cells
Absence of all T-cell subsets including gamma-delta T cells
More severe clinical presentation in early infancy
Clonal expansion of cytotoxic T cells
Presence of large granular lymphocytes on peripheral smear
Adult onset with cytopenias and autoimmune features

redFlags: Profound lymphopenia with absent TCR-alpha-beta-positive T cells
Failure to thrive and chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis in infancy
references: Notarangelo LD. Primary immunodeficiencies. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2010;125(2 Suppl 2):S182-94.

Al-Herz W, Bousfiha A, Casanova JL, et al. Primary immunodeficiency diseases: an update on the classification from the International Union of Immunological Societies Expert Committee for Primary Immunodeficiency. Front Immunol. 2014;5:162.
Orphanet: TCR-alpha-beta-positive T-cell deficiency. Orphanet Report Series. 2023.
